title: Counting sets with small sumset
abstract: Lean 4 formalization of Green's paper Counting sets with small sumset, and the clique number of random Cayley graphs. For a finite abelian group Γ, let S_k^m(Γ) be the family of the sets X in Γ with |X| = k whose restricted sumset X ∔ X = {x + y : x, y in X, x ≠ y} has m elements. The paper bounds |S_k^m(Γ)| for Γ = Z/NZ and Γ = F_2^n, through a bound for the number of Freiman isomorphism classes of sets with small restricted sumset in a vector space. It deduces that the Cayley sum graph of a random subset of Z/NZ almost surely has clique number at most 160 log_2 N, and that the Cayley graph of a random subset of F_2^n almost surely has clique number between C_1 n log_2 n and C_2 n log_2 n. The formalization proves these results with C_1 = 1/4 and C_2 = 308, both as limits and as explicit bounds on the number of exceptional sets.
